author: RISD Nature Lab (RISDNaturelab); scan by Vir Naidu
note: Real surface scan of RISD Nature Lab accession 132.32, reassembled from eggshell fragments and presumed by the collection to be an elephant-bird egg. Uniformly calibrated to the catalog’s representative 33 cm long axis, not a measured dimension or confirmed species identification of this particular specimen. Scan cracks and repaired fragments are retained; no invented shell geometry.

operations: Static-scene deduplication, flatten, join and weld
Simplify toward 45k triangles with maximum error 0.0008 (no independent axis deformation)
Prune; quantize positions to 16 bits, normals to 12 bits and in-range UVs to 14 bits; no mesh compression
processing.alignment: Surface-area-weighted principal long axis rigidly aligned to Y before calibration; pre-rotation X -20.697266 degrees, Z 2.150853 degrees.
